527:t_036:3.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「But the great $$ゲイツ$$ is different! As long as I have these sideburns, I can keep fighting forever!」

527:t_036:4.en:
$$レド$$
「Is the only way to beat him to drag him out of the cockpit and shave off his sideburns!?」

527:t_036:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Significant proposal. Engaging that opponent is judged unnecessary.」

527:t_037:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「Even $$カン・ユー$$ wasn't in a position this time to leisurely deliver a parting shot, it seems.」

527:t_037:1.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「His tenacity makes even me, the immortal, tip my hat.」

527:t_038:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Wait for me in the afterlife, $$マリリン$$. I'll finish off $$ファイヤバグ$$ properly myself, including the ones who aren't here.)

527:t_038:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
(And in the end, I'll be the one to vanish, and that's when $$ファイヤバグ$$ will be completely finished.)

527:t_039:1.en:
$$アル$$
「If a barrel extension kit is attached to the Demolition Gun, its range will increase dramatically.」

527:t_039:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「An AS carrying a demolition cannon, huh...」

527:t_039:3.en:
$$アル$$
「Transition to Gun Howitzer Mode complete.」

527:t_039:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「...It's getting too ridiculous to even be surprised anymore.」

527:t_039:5.en:
$$アル$$
「I will take that as a compliment.」

527:t_039:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「Equipment tailor-made for us...! We'll master it!」

527:t_100:0.en:
$$宗介$$
(Wait for me, $$千鳥$$...! I'm coming now!)

527:t_100:1.en:
$$宗介$$
(Whatever awaits me ahead, whatever stands in my way, I'll overcome all of it! To see you!)

527:t_101:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「From an elite special unit that completed any mission, to a ruthless mercenary unit, and now a subcontractor for $$アマルガム$$!」

527:t_101:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「How far you've fallen, $$ファイヤバグ$$! $$マリリン$$ is crying in the afterlife!」

527:t_102:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「What's with that new model! The $$ミスリル$$ models with the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ were white and blue!」

527:t_102:1.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Red is the color of the great $$ゲイツ$$ and $$シャア・アズナブル$$!!」

527:t_102:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「Is there any meaning to the color change?」

527:t_102:3.en:
$$アル$$
「The concept is apparently the color of burning flames.」

527:t_102:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Not bad. With that, I'll burn to ash everything that gets in my way!」

527:t_102:5.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Hey! Are you going to ignore me, Trash Collector!?」

527:t_102:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then, true to a trash collector, we'll gather up the trash and incinerate it!」

527:t_103:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$レーバテイン$$... Seems like a decent machine.」

527:t_103:1.en:
$$アル$$
「You are welcome to praise it more honestly.」

527:t_103:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「The AI has some minor problems.」

527:t_103:3.en:
$$アル$$
「If we are speaking of problems, the operator is the one who shows them.」

527:t_103:4.en:
$$アル$$
「Furthermore, due to various circumstances, this $$レーバテイン$$ could not be fitted with electronic warfare weaponry.」

527:t_103:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「The operator, the AI, and the machine are all full of problems.」

527:t_103:8.en:
$$アル$$
「I agree with two of those.」

527:t_103:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「But if we join forces, we can bring out our greatest strength! Let's show them!」

527:t_103:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「Let's do it! We counterattack from here!」

527:t_104:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
($$レナード$$... If you are here, I will make you realize...)

527:t_104:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
(that no matter what methods you use or how much force you assemble, there are people all over the world who will never bow to you or the Empire...!)

527:t_105:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(The adjustment of the chest laser cannon's convergence rate is complete as well. Now I can also use it as a higher-power laser cannon.)

527:t_105:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(This is no situation where I can just command from the rear. I'll master this power too.)

527:t_106:0.en:
$$スザク$$
($$ロイド$$, $$セシル$$... So you two are fighting for the world as well.)

527:t_106:1.en:
$$スザク$$
(The Albion, strengthened with the data you two prepared...! I'll fight with this power too!)

527:t_107:0.en:
$$カレン$$
(Thank you, $$テッサ$$, $$ラクシャータ$$! It's the perfect finish!)

527:t_107:1.en:
$$カレン$$
(Let's go, $$紅蓮$$! Nobody can stop us!)

527:t_108:0.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
($$ロイド$$ and $$セシル$$ have done something unnecessary. With my machine upgraded, I can't slack off in the rear anymore.)

527:t_108:1.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
(...The time really is near... I have a feeling everything will soon come to light...)

kept_omissions: 527:t_036:5: Chamber's proposal has no stated subject (engaging the opponent is unnecessary; judged by Chamber)

破砕砲 = 'demolition cannon' vs デモリッションガン 'Demolition Gun' (same weapon, two names)
チェインバー 有意提言 = 'Significant proposal.'
このゲイツ様 = 'the great Gates'
